product_launches.description: Ray is an open-source AI compute engine that simplifies scaling AI applications across machines and GPUs.

overview_description.description: Anyscale develops cloud-based software that enables organizations to build, deploy, and manage distributed artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads at scale. The company provides a managed platform built on the open-source Ray framework, offering tools for distributed data processing, model training, batch inference, online inference, workload orchestration, observability, autoscaling, and resource management across cloud and Kubernetes environments. Its platform supports AI application development through integrations with machine learning frameworks, large language model tooling, GPUs, and cloud infrastructure while providing governance, monitoring, and developer productivity features. Anyscale also offers enterprise capabilities for multi-cloud deployment, workload optimization, collaboration, security, and technical support to help organizations operate production AI systems. The company's technology enables developers and data science teams to execute distributed computing workloads, optimize infrastructure utilization, and accelerate the development and deployment of AI and machine learning applications.
